newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: KL tin ends down four cents to below 15 rgt.
newsitem.headline: KL tin ends down four cents to below 15 rgt.

text.p: Tin price ended down four cents at 14.96 ringgit ($5.99) a kg mainly due to a lower London market overnight and reduced buying, traders said.
"The market fell in line with losses in London," a trader said, adding that buying from overseas was also reduced.
Turnover fell to 92 tonnes from 101 on Monday with buying from Malaysia and Europe.
The local price differential over London was at $45 a tonne premium against $10 a tonne previously.
